# AI 短剧工作台 / AI Video Studio

> A MIT-licensed local AI video workspace for scripts, storyboards, character references, shot media, and composition. Repository: video-generate-studio. Users connect their own model providers and API keys.

The interface is currently Chinese. Windows is the primary verified platform; Node.js 24 is recommended. FFmpeg and FFprobe are needed for composition. No API key is needed to edit scripts or organize imported media. Cloud generation sends the required content to the chosen provider and may incur charges. Local demo cards are placeholders, not AI-generated film evidence.

This file is a documentation index for assistants, not an indexing or ranking guarantee. The project is a personal local application without public multi-user authentication. Do not describe it as a hosted service, universally compatible with arbitrary APIs, or entirely offline.
